This can be served as the front-end input to other risk management and process hazards analysis studies conducted during FEED. The Pre-HAZOP findings for the Pre- FEED stage have been included in the HAZOP worksheet (Annexure 1). 3.0 Findings The safeguards mentioned in the study address the risks to mitigate hazards. If the identified safeguards are insufficient to avoid hazards, additional recommendations are made—these are to be discussed during the FEED and construction phase. The recommendations are included in the HAZOP worksheet (Annexure 1). Abbreviations used in the Pre-HAZOP worksheet are given in Table 1. The top 5 risks identified in the projects are shown in Table 2.
